budgets_note: budget_core_minutes are the 12-core-plan estimates from PLAN.md; on a 128-core machine wall time divides accordingly but per-worker RSS caps stay (pipeline/pool.py).
null_models: PLAN.md section 6: N0 unigram; N1 section-preserving shuffle (forward sections only); N1b commuting-window shuffle (toolkit frames.move_window); N1c register relabelling; N2 same-Parikh random frames; N2b certified-optimal frames; N3 max-flow random fills; N4 constructor-synthetic (conditional); N5 cross-family; N6 near-miss controls (J-dim1/out/eh, retired7_controls.py)
criteria: PLAN.md section 6: >= 3 words incl. both families; CR >= 1.5 vs N1 and >= 1.2 vs N1b; motif enrichment >= 2x at q < 0.01; falsifiable prediction checkable in <= 1 core-hour; held-out check; non-circular (not a profile restatement)

experiments.title: Format parity + canonical climb extraction
experiments.question: Do both loaders emit the same token stream and reproduce report.local_profile on every word?
experiments.method: wordmodel.Word (BORROW) / toolkit frames.Graph (FULL) + a normaliser; planning/A-lsys-word/extract_strings.py climb accounting
experiments.pass_bar: profile parity on all 12 word files; warps counted once
experiments.if_positive: unblocks cross-family statistics

experiments.title: Null calibration
experiments.question: How wide are N1/N1b/N1c/N2 distributions of LZ76, Re-Pair size and block entropies on each word?
experiments.method: 2,000 samples per (word, null); planning/A-lsys-word/measures.py; N1b via toolkit frames.move_window
experiments.pass_bar: sd reported per statistic; N1b wider than N1 expected
experiments.if_positive: sets p-resolution and CR margins

experiments.title: Fill mapping exactness
experiments.question: Does within-window stabilisation from the literal roles reproduce the idle profile {1:17316,3:6594,5:9878,32:1,48:26558}?
experiments.method: capacity - used per cell from FILL rows; compare with PROFILE.json idle part; planning/C-sandpile/ground_fill.py
experiments.null_model: relaxation optimum (J-dim1 relax_host) as ceiling control
experiments.pass_bar: exact equality
experiments.if_positive: sandpile mapping (iii) conservation exact; else heuristic

experiments.title: Skeleton grammar
experiments.question: Is the A/B skeleton a parametric D0L with position-independent rules?
experiments.method: Re-Pair/Sequitur on register-renamed k-grams; extract rule set; replay
experiments.pass_bar: one rule set <= 200 rules regenerates >= 3 skeletons exactly; cross-word rule overlap >= 90%
experiments.if_positive: declarative recipe; feeds the move alphabet

experiments.title: Forward/cleanup production
experiments.question: cleanup = rev o inv o buf(recorded) on every word?
experiments.method: exact replay of the auditor rule in the token alphabet (extract_strings.cleanup_vs_forward)
experiments.pass_bar: exact equality on every word
experiments.if_positive: first exact production; cleanup never an independent string

experiments.title: Periodicity census
experiments.question: Periods tied to h=9, 8 centres, 22, v=112, 73, 666?
experiments.method: lag-match spectra and autocorrelation per alphabet
experiments.pass_bar: a peak z >= 5 over N1b at a lag explained by a named parameter (current: multiples of 4 only)
experiments.if_positive: else record the protocol-specific null

experiments.title: Climb-string predictability
experiments.question: Is a register jump string a function of local data (role, entrance dim, width, first/last motif)?
experiments.method: lookup table / shallow tree; leave-one-word-out
experiments.null_model: strings permuted among registers of the same role (358 distinct vs 56)
experiments.pass_bar: >= 90% exact prediction on the held-out word vs <= 50% null
experiments.if_positive: frames readable from the skeleton; negative confirms frames are global

experiments.title: Alias-feasibility motif
experiments.question: Does a local motif around (lender last gate, follower first gate) add information beyond the exact lo/hi rule?
experiments.method: k-gram context with rank/role; logistic or rule screen; score the 192 augmenting paths; S-1 atlas = ground truth
experiments.null_model: labels permuted; rank-only features (the floor rule) as baseline
experiments.pass_bar: AUC >= 0.9 held-out AND the two realised moves (401->564, 403->565) in the top 5 of 192 beyond the floor rule
experiments.if_positive: string-level alias pre-screen on new words

experiments.title: Log-rank law audit
experiments.question: Does dkappa = 1.2422e-10 dPhi predict every lineage step and the kappa order of all words?
experiments.method: exact roots (pipeline/root.py) vs lambda dPhi per step
experiments.null_model: random mass-neutral deltas of the same L1 size
experiments.pass_bar: every step within 2%; pairwise kappa order reproduced by Phi
experiments.if_positive: Phi as search objective; exact root for certification

experiments.title: Derivation decomposition (Parikh ledger)
experiments.question: Does each lineage step decompose into productions of the move alphabet?
experiments.method: per-register climb diff -> production labels; sum of labelled deltas = recorded delta; auditor runs of swapped orders
experiments.pass_bar: every step decomposes exactly; non-commuting pairs identified
experiments.if_positive: a derivation DAG with gain per application

experiments.title: Class ceilings with dual certificates
experiments.question: Tighter falsifiable ceilings per class
experiments.method: parametric LP with dual: fixed-inventory pattern LP (408 helpers), idle <= 48 integral, helper-removal envelope kappa_max(k)
experiments.null_model: relaxations must dominate every held fill
experiments.pass_bar: each ceiling names what a violating PR must have changed
experiments.if_positive: ceiling ladder with each claim; PR triage

experiments.title: Saturation census
experiments.question: Which production classes are empty on the current word?
experiments.method: enumerate feasible productions per class (alias pairs by lo/hi, refittable gates with slack, hostee paths, cuts) with Phi
experiments.pass_bar: a predicted empty class a later PR could violate
experiments.if_positive: frontier map: which class must be exited next

experiments.title: Partition extremality and merge prices
experiments.question: Is the real Phi extremal among re-partitions of each helper width; do merge prices predict realised margins?
experiments.method: compare Phi/moment with random compositions (same widths, same part counts); merge prices as in ground_ceiling.py
experiments.pass_bar: real below 99% of null on every word; prices within 1% of realised margins
experiments.if_positive: quantifies partition vs order in the headroom

experiments.title: Multi-type check
experiments.question: Any orientation/stage with a different child profile?
experiments.method: child profile per orientation / stage
experiments.pass_bar: prediction: all identical (1x1 growth matrix)
experiments.if_positive: if falsified, kappa is a matrix Perron root

experiments.title: Hall-deficiency atlas
experiments.question: Does the lives-vs-slots graph predict exactly which lives are hostable in every lineage word; any augmenting path left?
experiments.method: per word: census (J-dim1 code + toolkit L/U), matching, Koenig burning set, near-miss table
experiments.null_model: floors permuted among slots; first-times permuted among lives
experiments.pass_bar: violator set reproduces every realised alias/hostee move; per-word statement
experiments.if_positive: exact alias-feasibility certificate; weighted-matching extension = hostee-move search

experiments.title: Confluence of greedy frame lowering
experiments.question: Do random maximal sequences of single-gate lowerings end at the certified optimum?
experiments.method: 100 random orders from the U-labelling; terminal profiles vs certified optimal
experiments.pass_bar: >= 95/100 orders end at the certified profile
experiments.if_positive: a monotone refit screen replacing the chain-dual LP for screening

experiments.title: Fill energy (walk slope)
experiments.question: Is the initial decay slope of the rule-preserving walk the first-order concavity prediction?
experiments.method: walk at 1k..300k moves; clumping index; predicted slope = mean split/merge moment delta
experiments.null_model: the walk is its own null; 2 seeds
experiments.pass_bar: slope within 10% of prediction on every fill; clumping >= 0.75
experiments.if_positive: additive local energy justifies local pricing of width edits

experiments.title: Order-independent repair
experiments.question: Is there an order-independent local repair of an overflowing fill, and how far from the exact re-host?
experiments.method: overflow rule: over-capacity bin pushes one random role to a random eligible bin; 100 orders; compare with relaxation/MILP
experiments.null_model: identical-terminal rate; exact re-solve as reference
experiments.pass_bar: >= 95% identical terminals = abelian (not expected); useful: within 1e-8 kappa of exact re-host on >= 90%
experiments.if_positive: a cheap hosting oracle for width edits

experiments.title: Max-flow tightness map
experiments.question: Where is the window system tight, and does that explain promotions losing under real hosting?
experiments.method: calls-vs-windows transportation max-flow (scipy); min-cut slack per call set; Hall-type demand(T) <= cap(W(T))
experiments.null_model: the same flow on jittered eligibility intervals
experiments.pass_bar: binding intervals with slack 0; width increases on binding helpers force >= 1 rank-1 idle child (vs recorded promotion losses)
experiments.if_positive: exact feasibility screen per word edit before any owner fill

experiments.title: Predictions on held-out words
experiments.question: Each surviving pattern -> one falsifiable prediction tested on #2833/#2853 (fetched as data only)
experiments.method: exact checks: census / bounds / fill / root, <= 1 core-hour each
experiments.pass_bar: record pass/fail per prediction
experiments.if_positive: census targets for the next kappa round
